meta.title: Grumps — Gets it done. Remembers what matters.
hero.desc: An AI agent that lives in your group. Remembers what you decide, plans what's next, reminds the right person at the right time. Open the workspace when you need the full picture.
hero.note: Free for 1 group · No app to install · Workspace-private memory
hero.chat.msg2: Tuesday 14:00 — building lobby. Booked 6 weeks ago. I'll remind @Bob the day before.
hero.chat.msg3: make it 2 days before, I work late Mon
hero.chat.msg4: Done. Sunday 18:00 instead. Saved as your default for inspections.
remembers.label: What it remembers
remembers.title: Three kinds of memory. Yours, not ours.
remembers.subtitle: Workspace-scoped: nothing crosses groups. You can pin, edit or wipe any of it.
remembers.col1.title: Things about your group
remembers.col1.desc: People, preferences, recurring details. The bot learns them as you talk and surfaces them when relevant.
remembers.col2.title: What you agreed on
remembers.col2.desc: Choices, plans, who's doing what — kept with the context. No more "wait, what did we decide?".
remembers.col2.ex2: Bob handles utilities. Alice handles groceries.
remembers.col3.title: What's coming up
remembers.col3.desc: Deadlines, recurring chores, follow-ups. The bot keeps the calendar — and pings the right person at the right moment.
remembers.col3.ex2: Take out the trash every Tuesday.
remembers.col3.ex3: Follow up with the landlord in 2 weeks.
how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps. Zero friction.
how.subtitle: No app to download. No signup form. No onboarding wizard.
how.step1.title: Add it to your group
how.step1.desc: One contact to add. The workspace is created automatically and only the people in the group can access it.
how.step2.title: Talk like a person
how.step2.desc: No commands to learn. "Remind us Tuesday." "Note down the WiFi." "What did we decide about the trip?". The agent figures the rest out.
how.step3.title: It remembers and acts
how.step3.desc: Plans, reminds, follows up — without being asked twice. Open the workspace anytime to see todos, calendar, notes, decisions and history.
features.label: Features
features.title: An agent. A memory. A real workspace.
features.subtitle: Everything you say in the chat is captured, structured, recallable. Everything you do on the web syncs back.
features.memory.title: Memory that compounds
features.memory.desc: Structured facts plus semantic search across every message. The agent finds what you said three months ago in seconds. You decide what stays, what gets pinned, what gets forgotten.
features.schedule.title: Schedule anything
features.schedule.desc: One-time reminders, recurring chores, conditional follow-ups. "Ping me if Bob hasn't replied by Friday" — that's a single sentence.
features.schedule.chip_text: Every Tuesday at 09:00 — take out the trash
features.calendar.title: A real calendar
features.calendar.desc: Events, todos with deadlines, recurring tasks, scheduled actions — one timeline. Export as iCal to Google, Apple or Outlook. The agent talks to your existing calendar so nothing falls through.
features.todos.title: Todos that stick
features.todos.desc: Add from chat in plain language. Assign people, set deadlines, add priorities. Reply "done" to a task card to complete. List or kanban view on the web.
features.notes.title: Notes that don't get buried
features.notes.desc: Pin important info from the chat. WiFi passwords, house rules, contact details — always findable, always editable in a real Markdown editor on the web.
features.files.title: Files in one place
features.files.desc: Reply "save this" to any image or document. Stored, named, previewable on the web. No more scrolling back through months of messages to find the lease.
features.web.title: Web search built-in
features.web.desc: "Find a plumber near Lyon open Sunday." The agent searches the web, cites its sources, and pins the answer if you ask. Open backend (Brave today, self-hosted SearXNG soon).
features.workspace.title: A workspace, not a dashboard
features.workspace.desc: Memory, calendar, scheduled actions, todos, notes, files, history, settings. Member-only access via phone OTP — no passwords, no email signup. Mobile-friendly. Dark mode. Export your data anytime.
features.workspace.memo_fact: Bob prefers reminders 2 days before any inspection.
talks.label: How it talks back
talks.title: Three real conversations.
talks.subtitle: Not a feature list — actual exchanges with the agent.
talks.s1.l1: @grumps we want to go somewhere warm in October, 4 of us, max €600pp
talks.s1.l2: Noted. Lisbon, Sevilla, Athens fit your budget that month. Want me to draft a poll?
talks.s1.l4: Posted. I'll close it Sunday and book the winning option's flights for review.
talks.s2.l2: Logged. Split 4 ways: Alice owes €21.75, Bob €21.75, Marie €21.75. Updated the tally.
talks.s2.l3: how much do I owe everyone right now?
talks.s2.l4: Net: you owe Tom €34.10. Everyone else is even with you.
talks.s3.l1: we keep forgetting to water the plants when one of us is away
talks.s3.l2: I can ping whoever's home every Wednesday. Want me to check the calendar to know who's around?
talks.s3.l4: Set up. First ping: tomorrow, @Marie (Bob and Alice both away).
